verdict.rationale: Sierra ships a first-party Agent SDK for writing customer journeys as code. Its product page says the SDK fits existing development workflows with change tracking, offers API-call and logic-trace inspection, supports regression testing, and deploys across channels, including via CI/CD. The evidence is marketing-level only: there is no detail on supported languages or packages, no API reference (the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returned 404), only one SDK rather than SDKs plural, and no independent hands-on use. Missing for 10: SDK language/package details and reference docs, evidence of multiple official SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
